question: Which of the following countries will host the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qatar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **FIFA world cup 2022** will be** hosted by Qatar**.

 
 
• There will be** 32 teams **that will be participating in the event.
 
• It is the** first FIFA event** to be **hosted **in the **Arab world**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FIFA World Cup**

 
 
• It is an **international football competition **held **every four years**.
 
• It was **started **in **1904**.
 
• President: **Gianni Infantino.**
 
• FIFA Headquarters: **Zurich**, **Switzerland**.
